novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement route in the phrases "gradient-ascending on the linearly-probed backdoor direction in soft-embedding space" and "the SHAPE of this generalization surface" as a diagnostic, rather than merely applying a probe for detection. The closest prior work found was *The Trigger in the Haystack: Extracting and Reconstructing LLM Backdoor Triggers* (2026), which recovers working triggers without prior trigger knowledge, and *Semantic and Precise Trigger Inversion* (2025), which uses optimized trigger inversion for semantically constrained triggers; searches included "LLM backdoor trigger inversion", "activation maximization backdoor trigger recovery", "soft prompt gradient trigger synthesis", and "backdoor trigger generalization surface". Relative to these works, probe-guided feature-visualization synthesis and surface-shape descriptors are a non-trivial combination and adaptation, but the step is still a natural extension of established trigger inversion, activation maximization, and backdoor activation analysis rather than a wholly new core paradigm, so this merits standard-to-moderately-high novelty.
